title: TransferRecord
description: A typed source object and its proposed target binding in one immutable staging revision.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

job_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

source_revision.description: Source snapshot key or content-derived revision.

source_locator.description: Archive relative path and node selector, not an arbitrary URL.

source_fingerprint.description: Digest of preserved source record identity, bytes and projection-relevant metadata.

parent_record_id.description: Structural parent within the same job.
parent_record_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

dependency_record_ids.description: Typed job record dependencies validated against the staging graph.
dependency_record_ids.x-reference-scope: Every referenced record belongs to this transfer job.

target_id.description: Canonical target identity in the registered owner domain.

target_revision_id.description: Target immutable version or staged pointer.

baseline_target_digest.description: Target fingerprint used in three-way comparison.

disposition.description: Machine-produced coverage classification, review decision stored independently.

x-invariants: References stay within the job graph or an explicit authorized external map.
Protected drafts are not visible to learners.
Every processed or blocked source object contributes to the reconciliation totals.
